    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Card
    An entirely immutable Card class.
    CardColour
    Enum representation of card colours to serve as a constraint.
    CardContainer
    While no new methods are added compared to what a List contains, I opted to include this as it is more explicit and deliberate, making the code easier to read.
    CardValue
    Constraints added to what values the cards can be by way of an enum.
    Deck
    Uno deck, loaded based on a pair of 1-9 numbers per colour, plus one 0 card per colour, 3 pairs of action cards per colour, and 4 lots of both wild card and wild draw four cards (= 108 cards).
